quiz.0.question: Who is credited as the pioneer of Timorasso's revival?
quiz.0.explanation: Walter Massa of Monleale single-handedly revived Timorasso in the 1980s–90s, transforming it from a nearly extinct variety into one of Piemonte's most sought-after white wines.
quiz.1.question: What is Ruché's most distinctive flavour characteristic?
quiz.1.options.1: Unique combination of rose petals, geranium, white pepper and exotic spice
quiz.1.explanation: Ruché di Castagnole Monferrato DOCG is unlike any other Italian red — its extraordinary aromatic profile of rose, geranium and exotic spices makes it instantly recognisable.
quiz.2.question: How many different styles can Freisa be produced in?
quiz.2.options.1: Three: dry still, sweet (amabile), and lightly sparkling (frizzante)
quiz.2.explanation: Freisa is remarkably versatile — it can be made as a dry still red, a gently sweet (amabile) version or a lightly sparkling (frizzante) wine — all with its characteristic raspberry and tar character.
quiz.3.question: What is Timorasso's typical ageing potential?
quiz.3.explanation: Top Timorasso (Colli Tortonesi DOC) can age for 10–20 years, developing a remarkable mineral, petrolly complexity similar to great aged Riesling — extraordinary for a Piemontese white.
